story.so_that: Skill owners can trust that every accepted state improves measurable quality (more passing evaluations or new required coverage) and that every terminal report can be independently replayed and verified without manual intervention, so accepted skill state only moves forward and audit outcomes remain independently reproducible
story.i_want: each valid candidate evaluated comparably, accepted only when it adds qualifying value, and summarized with the repository left at its best accepted state

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a refinement action has completed and passed scope validation, when the candidate is evaluated, then the same deterministic evaluation command, configuration, and pinned provider used for the baseline are invoked again.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a refinement action has completed and passed scope validation when the candidate is evaluated then the same deterministic evaluation command configuration and pinned provider used for the baseline are invoked again

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the candidate evaluation completes, when results are recorded, then structured passing, failing, total, percentage, and required-coverage metrics and artifact references are captured.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation completes when results are recorded then structured passing failing total percentage and required-coverage metrics and artifact references are captured

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the candidate evaluation exceeds its configured Activity timeout, when the timeout is reached, then the attempt is recorded, the configured retry policy is applied, and the attempt does not count as an additional logical iteration.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation exceeds its configured Activity timeout when the timeout is reached then the attempt is recorded the configured retry policy is applied and the attempt does not count as an additional logical iteration

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the evaluation Activity errors for infrastructure reasons, when the failure is recorded, then it is not treated by itself as evidence of a product regression.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the evaluation Activity errors for infrastructure reasons when the failure is recorded then it is not treated by itself as evidence of a product regression

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a candidate increases the absolute number of passing evaluations without reducing required test-case coverage, when comparison completes, then the change is committed deterministically, the consecutive-regression counter resets, and the candidate becomes the new best accepted state.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate increases the absolute number of passing evaluations without reducing required test-case coverage when comparison completes then the change is committed deterministically the consecutive-regression counter resets and the candidate becomes the new best accepted state

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a candidate covers a previously uncovered required test case while preserving the prior absolute passing count, when comparison completes, then the change may be committed and accepted even if a larger denominator lowers the pass percentage.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate covers a previously uncovered required test case while preserving the prior absolute passing count when comparison completes then the change may be committed and accepted even if a larger denominator lowers the pass percentage

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given every required test case is already covered and a candidate only increases the total evaluation count, when comparison completes, then the candidate is not classified or committed as an improvement.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given every required test case is already covered and a candidate only increases the total evaluation count when comparison completes then the candidate is not classified or committed as an improvement

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a candidate performs worse than the current best accepted state, when comparison completes, then it is not immediately reverted or committed, and the workflow reruns the complete suite against the unchanged candidate before deciding.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate performs worse than the current best accepted state when comparison completes then it is not immediately reverted or committed and the workflow reruns the complete suite against the unchanged candidate before deciding

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a candidate neither improves passing count nor adds meaningful coverage, when comparison completes, then no commit is made and the reason no qualifying value was added is recorded.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a candidate neither improves passing count nor adds meaningful coverage when comparison completes then no commit is made and the reason no qualifying value was added is recorded

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given an evaluation expectation change was applied with human approval, when comparing before-change and after-change scores, then the two measurement contexts are kept separate rather than treated as directly comparable.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an evaluation expectation change was applied with human approval when comparing before-change and after-change scores then the two measurement contexts are kept separate rather than treated as directly comparable

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome, when finalization runs, then it publishes a terminal progress record and workflow result containing baseline and final metrics, absolute changes, terminal reason, accepted iteration and commit references, and rejected or reverted iteration summaries.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome when finalization runs then it publishes a terminal progress record and workflow result containing baseline and final metrics absolute changes terminal reason accepted iteration and commit references and rejected or reverted iteration summaries

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome, when finalization completes, then the repository mutation lease is released and the progress record identifies the target repository and final accepted commit.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run reaches any terminal outcome when finalization completes then the repository mutation lease is released and the progress record identifies the target repository and final accepted commit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given a run finalizes, when the terminal repository state is checked, then it corresponds to the best accepted state, not merely the last attempted state.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a run finalizes when the terminal repository state is checked then it corresponds to the best accepted state not merely the last attempted state

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given pending human decisions or flaky-result evidence exist at the time of termination, when the report is published, then those pending or resolved items are included in the report rather than silently dropped.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given pending human decisions or flaky-result evidence exist at the time of termination when the report is published then those pending or resolved items are included in the report rather than silently dropped

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given the workflow terminates due to an unrecoverable error before any commit is accepted, when finalization runs, then the report still identifies the target repository, the failure reason, and that no accepted commit exists, and the lease is still released.
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the workflow terminates due to an unrecoverable error before any commit is accepted when finalization runs then the report still identifies the target repository the failure reason and that no accepted commit exists and the lease is still released

edge_cases.criterion: Candidate evaluation produces empty or malformed metrics
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate evaluation returns no metrics or a malformed metric payload when results are recorded then the workflow rejects the candidate and records the reason

edge_cases.criterion: Baseline metrics are missing when comparison runs
edge_cases.gherkin: Given no baseline or current-best accepted metrics exist when the quality-ratchet comparison runs then the workflow records the missing baseline and rejects the candidate

edge_cases.criterion: Evaluation provider version is not pinned
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the configured provider version is not pinned when the evaluation Activity runs then the workflow records a non-determinism warning and does not use the result for acceptance

edge_cases.criterion: Deterministic evaluation command differs from the baseline command
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation command differs from the baseline command when the evaluation is invoked then the workflow uses the baseline command and records the deviation

edge_cases.criterion: Activity timeout is reached during evaluation
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the candidate evaluation exceeds the configured Activity timeout when the timeout is reached then the attempt is recorded the retry policy is applied and the logical iteration count is unchanged
Given all configured retries for a candidate evaluation fail when the last retry is exhausted then the failure is recorded and the candidate is not accepted

edge_cases.criterion: Candidate has the same absolute passing count and no new required coverage
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate has the same absolute passing count and no new required coverage when comparison completes then the candidate is rejected and the reason is recorded

edge_cases.criterion: Candidate improves percentage but loses an absolute passing case
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate improves the pass percentage but reduces the absolute passing count when comparison completes then the candidate is not accepted

edge_cases.criterion: Required coverage is reduced by a candidate
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a candidate reduces required test-case coverage when comparison completes then the candidate is rejected even if the pass count increased

edge_cases.criterion: Human-approved expectation change separates measurement contexts
edge_cases.gherkin: Given a human-approved evaluation expectation change exists when comparing scores then the before-change and after-change measurement contexts are kept separate

edge_cases.criterion: Repository mutation lease is already released before finalization
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the mutation lease is already released when finalization runs then the workflow records the state and proceeds with terminal reporting

edge_cases.criterion: No accepted commit exists at termination
edge_cases.gherkin: Given no candidate was accepted when the run finalizes then the terminal report states no accepted commit exists and the lease is still released

edge_cases.criterion: Pending human decisions or flaky evidence exist at termination
edge_cases.gherkin: Given pending human decisions or flaky-result evidence exist at termination when the report is published then the report includes those items

edge_cases.criterion: Final repository state does not match best accepted commit
edge_cases.gherkin: Given the repository HEAD is not at the best accepted commit when finalization completes then the workflow restores the repository to the best accepted commit

edge_cases.criterion: Concurrent finalization attempts for the same run
edge_cases.gherkin: Given two finalization attempts run concurrently for the same run when finalization completes then the terminal record is published exactly once and the lease is released exactly once

steps.description: Add EvaluationRunConfiguration and CandidateMetricRecord data models to the progress record module, including measurement_context, pinned_provider_version, and artifact_references.
Implement the evaluate_candidate Activity in the backend with a deterministic command, configuration, and pinned provider; wrap it in the configured Activity timeout and retry policy.
Record structured passing, failing, total, percentage, required-coverage metrics and artifact references for each completed evaluation attempt, including timeout and infrastructure status.
Bump the ProgressRecord schema version and ensure existing run records remain forward-compatible.

Stub the compare_candidate_to_best service, commit_accepted_candidate Activity, rerun_degraded_candidate Activity, and finalize_run Activity for the first slice so the workflow remains compilable and the contracts are defined.
Wire the candidate evaluation path into the EDD refinement workflow so it is invoked after scope validation and stores the CandidateMetricRecord in the ProgressRecord.
Add frontend status display for evaluation trigger, in-progress state, attempt count, and timeout/retry state.
Implement the compare_candidate_to_best service using absolute passing count and required-coverage rules, with separate measurement contexts for human-approved expectation changes.
Implement commit_accepted_candidate Activity to commit the accepted candidate, update the best accepted state, and reset the consecutive-regression counter.
Implement rerun_degraded_candidate Activity to rerun the complete suite unchanged and classify confirmed regressions.
Implement finalize_run Activity to publish a schema-versioned terminal report, release the mutation lease, and restore the repository to the best accepted state, using a run-scoped idempotency key.
Add frontend views for the quality-ratchet comparison and the finalization and audit report.

unit_tests.description: CandidateMetricRecord serialization and schema version handling
Evaluation timeout and retry do not increment the logical iteration count
Quality-ratchet comparison with absolute passing count and required-coverage rules
Measurement context separation for human-approved expectation changes

integration_tests.description: Evaluate a candidate using the baseline command, configuration, and pinned provider
Record metrics and artifact references in the ProgressRecord
Run the full candidate evaluation through the workflow after scope validation

e2e_tests.description: Run an EDD refinement workflow from candidate validation through metric recording
Display the quality-ratchet comparison and finalization report in the frontend

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Provider version drift makes baseline and candidate metrics incomparable
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Lock the pinned provider version in EvaluationRunConfiguration and fail closed if it is missing or different

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Timeout and infrastructure errors are mistaken for product regressions
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Record these as non-iteration attempts with explicit status and do not use them as ratchet evidence

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Percentage-only 'improvements' that reduce absolute passing count are committed
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Base acceptance strictly on absolute passing count and required-coverage rules

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Flaky evaluation results lead to incorrect regression classification
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Rerun degraded candidates unchanged once before confirming a regression and capture flaky evidence

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Concurrent finalization attempts duplicate the terminal report or lease release
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use a run-scoped idempotency key and record-once guards in finalize_run

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Sensitive environment data leaks into terminal reports
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Redact credentials, paths, and environment variables before writing metric and terminal records
